passport.title: Colima Passport
passport.cardPitch: Beaches, rivers, mountains and more: stamp each place when you arrive and see how much of Colima you've explored.
passport.intro: Stamp each natural or tourist spot when you get there. Your stamps are saved in this browser.
passport.hint: When you're here, stamp your passport. We ask for your location only at that moment and we don't store it.
passport.tooFar: You're about {meters} m from this place. Get closer to stamp it.
passport.nothingNear: You're not within {meters} m of a place to stamp.
passport.denied: Without location permission we can't stamp. Enable it in your browser's site settings.
passport.locationError: We couldn't read your location. Please try again.
passport.empty: You have no stamps yet. When you reach a place, tap “Stamp where I am”.
